newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - New York ADRs quiet, Telebras off.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - New York ADRs quiet, Telebras off.

text.p: Foreign shares were mostly quiet on Friday, with Brazilian telephone company Telebras off on trade worries, traders said.
Most American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) were following the broader market slightly lower on profit-taking.

State-run Telebras was off 1-1/4 to 76-1/2 on concerns that Brazil's trade deficit could widen to as much as $1 billion in October, up from $655 million in September. The trade figures are expected out on Friday.
"It's down on the trade balance (which) might be worse than expected, and on profit-taking in the U.S.," one trader said.

Among European ADRs, Britain's Unilever Plc rose 4-1/2 to 89-1/8 on strong third-quarter results. French semiconductor maker Thomson-CSF was up 1-3/8 to 58-5/8 after Morgan Stanley put it on its list of 40 recommended world stocks.

British Airways rose one to 94-1/2 after it dismissed a report that the European Commission had demanded it give up a third of the runway slots it uses at London's Heathrow Airport as a condition for approving its alliance with AMR Corp's American Airlines.
Decliners led advancers 215 to 240 in an index of 807 stocks. Volume in the late morning was 27 million shares.
